jei.actualgenerators.filter: Two lists: what passes, and what never does. Set it up by using it, then drop it into a pad's filter slot. Craft it with a blank Filter to copy it, alone to clear it.
jei.actualgenerators.flux_crystal: A battery in item form. Any machine or charger that takes a battery takes one of these, so energy can be crafted, stored on a shelf, or piped around as an item.
jei.actualgenerators.linking_tool: Use on a Logic Port pad or an Energy Injector to put it on a network: name a new one or pick one from the list. Held, it shows every pad in view, its network, and the network's centre.
